pages.title: Primordial Ocean Simulacrum
pages.text: A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, the space where physical laws bubble up and fall back. It is still bubbling inside its lattice, each bubble a possible rule. When I hold it close I can hear it, like distant surf.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex Engine first had to simulate the Ocean itself, using its own previous run as a seed under a Primordial Law. Each iteration added more bubbles, until the simulation was complete.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment, Axiom Key, Crystallised Law, Omega Point, Omnilex, Omnilex Seal and more.
